sections.html:
TREATMENTS INCLUDED IN FULL MOUTH RESTORATION

01

Dental Implants

Dental implants are the gold standard for replacing missing teeth. These titanium posts are surgically placed into the jawbone, where they fuse with the bone to create a permanent foundation for crowns, bridges, or dentures. Implants look, feel, and function like natural teeth.

02

Crowns & Bridges

Dental crowns cap damaged or weakened teeth to restore their strength and appearance. Bridges replace one or more missing teeth by anchoring artificial teeth to the surrounding natural teeth or implants. Both are custom-made to match your natural smile.

03

Porcelain Veneers

Veneers are thin shells of porcelain bonded to the front of teeth to improve their appearance. They can correct chips, cracks, stains, gaps, and minor misalignment, creating a uniform, beautiful smile that looks completely natural.

04

Dentures & Partials

Modern dentures and partial dentures offer a comfortable, natural-looking solution for replacing multiple missing teeth. We offer both traditional removable options and implant-supported dentures for enhanced stability and function.

05

Periodontal Treatment

Healthy gums are the foundation of any successful restoration. We provide comprehensive gum disease treatment, including deep cleaning, scaling and root planing, and other therapies to ensure your gums are healthy before and after your restoration.

06

All-on-X Dental Implants

All-on-X is a revolutionary full-arch replacement technique that uses just four to six strategically angled implants to support an entire arch of teeth. Unlike traditional implants that replace teeth one by one, All-on-X anchors a custom-designed prosthetic bridge to fewer implants, often eliminating the need for bone grafting. Many patients can receive a fully functional set of temporary teeth the same day as their procedure, making it one of the most efficient paths to a complete smile.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How long does full mouth restoration take?

The timeline varies depending on the complexity of your case and the treatments involved. Simple restorations may take a few months, while more extensive cases involving implants and bone grafting can take 12-18 months. During your consultation, we'll provide a detailed timeline specific to your treatment plan.

Is full mouth restoration painful?

We prioritize your comfort throughout the entire process. Local anesthesia is used during procedures, and we offer sedation options for patients with dental anxiety. Most patients report minimal discomfort, and any post-procedure soreness can typically be managed with over-the-counter pain medication.

How much does full mouth restoration cost?

The cost varies significantly based on the treatments required. During your consultation, we'll provide a comprehensive treatment plan with transparent pricing. We also offer flexible payment plans and work with most dental insurance providers to help make your treatment affordable.

How long will my restoration last?

With proper care and regular dental checkups, most restorations can last 15-20 years or longer. Dental implants, in particular, can last a lifetime with good oral hygiene. We'll provide detailed care instructions to help you maximize the longevity of your new smile.

Can I get full mouth restoration if I have gum disease?

Yes, but gum disease must be treated first. Healthy gums are essential for the success of any dental restoration. We'll address any periodontal issues as part of your comprehensive treatment plan before proceeding with restorative procedures.

What should I expect during my first visit?

Your first visit includes a comprehensive dental exam, where your dentist will review your medical and dental history. They’ll perform a thorough cleaning if needed, take X-rays, and discuss any potential treatment plans. The goal is to develop a personalized approach to maintaining or improving your oral health.

Do you offer emergency dental services?

Yes, Cosmetic & Implant Dentistry of Kansas City provides same-day emergency dental services. Whether you are dealing with a severe toothache, trauma, or a chipped tooth, their team is ready to help. Prompt care is essential to relieving pain and preventing further complications.

How can I manage dental anxiety during my visit?

The practice is designed to reduce anxiety by offering a spa-like atmosphere. Patients can enjoy amenities like massage chairs, calming music, and a gentle approach to care. They also use modern technology to ensure treatments are as comfortable and efficient as possible.

What cosmetic dental procedures do you offer?

They offer a variety of cosmetic dental services to enhance the appearance of your smile. Treatments include professional teeth whitening, veneers, bonding, and ClearCorrect aligners. Each procedure is tailored to your specific needs to give you the most natural and appealing results.

What financing options are available for treatments?

Financing options are available to make dental care more affordable. Cosmetic & Implant Dentistry of Kansas City partners with Cherry, a healthcare financing service, to offer flexible payment plans. It is recommended to schedule dental cleanings and exams every six months. Regular check-ups help prevent the buildup of plaque and tartar, catch potential issues early, and maintain overall oral health. Your dentist may recommend more frequent visits if specific dental issues need monitoring.

Pediatric services include comprehensive exams, cleanings, fluoride treatments, and sealants to protect against cavities. The team creates a fun and gentle environment to help children feel comfortable and develop good dental habits. Starting regular visits early helps ensure healthy smiles as they grow.

A web beacon is a transparent graphic image placed on a web page or in an email, which indicates that a page or email has been viewed or that an email has been forwarded. In addition, a web beacon allows third parties to obtain information such as the IP address of the computer that downloaded the page on which the beacon appears, the URL of the page on which the beacon appears, the time the page containing the beacon was viewed, the type of browser used to view the page, and the information in cookies set by the third party. A web beacon may also tell your browser to get content from another server.

Is sedation right for you?

WHO CAN BENEFIT FROM SEDATION DENTISTRY

Sedation dentistry is an excellent option for patients who experience:

  • High dental anxiety or fear of dental procedures
  • Heightened sensitivity to pain or discomfort
  • Difficulty getting numb with local anesthesia alone
  • Strong gag reflex that interferes with treatment
  • Need for extensive dental work in fewer visits
  • Past traumatic dental experiences
  • Difficulty sitting still for extended periods
  • Fear of needles or dental instruments

TYPES OF SEDATION WE OFFER

01

Nitrous Oxide (Laughing Gas)

Nitrous oxide is a mild sedative inhaled through a mask that helps you relax during your procedure. It takes effect quickly and wears off fast, allowing you to drive yourself home after your appointment. This is an excellent option for patients with mild to moderate anxiety.

02

Oral Sedation

Oral sedation involves taking a prescribed medication before your appointment to help you feel deeply relaxed. While you'll remain conscious and able to respond to instructions, you may feel drowsy and have little memory of the procedure afterward. You'll need someone to drive you to and from your appointment.

03

IV Sedation

For patients with severe anxiety or those undergoing extensive procedures, IV sedation delivers medication directly into the bloodstream for a deeper level of relaxation. You'll be in a sleep-like state but can still respond to verbal cues. This option provides the highest level of sedation while keeping you safe and comfortable.

Will I be unconscious during the procedure?
